subject: Chloe Fineman
headline: chloe fineman lands first role since leaving snl
body: she'll star in netflix's myron bolitar opposite jabari banks, his first show since bel-air.
slide2: jamie mcshane (task, wednesday) joins as a series regular too, alongside ben mckenzie in the cast.

subject: Julia Garner
headline: julia garner is playing a real murder suspect
body: apple ordered the thriller with her as lead and executive producer.
slide2: lewis pullman stars opposite her. it's adapted from mikita brottman's book about a killing in tallahassee.
